title: Geometry optimization of chalcopyrite structures
action: Perform DFT geometry relaxation for the tetragonal I-42d chalcopyrite phase of BeSiP₂, MgSiP₂, CdSiP₂, ZnSiP₂, and HgSiP₂ to obtain equilibrium lattice parameters and atomic positions.
description: Optimize the crystal structures of all five compounds in the chalcopyrite space group using DFT (PAW PBE) with adequate k-point mesh and energy cutoff. The relaxed structures are the foundation for subsequent elastic, phonon, and equation-of-state calculations.

title: Single-crystal elastic constants
action: Calculate the elastic stiffness tensor C_ij for the chalcopyrite phase of each compound by applying small finite strains to the relaxed structure, computing stress, and fitting Hooke's law.
description: Produce a JSON array of objects, each with keys: compound (string), C11, C12, C13, C33, C44, C66 (all float, GPa). One object per compound.
output_schema: Array of objects: {compound: string, C11: number, C12: number, C13: number, C33: number, C44: number, C66: number}

title: Phonon dynamical stability
action: Compute phonon dispersion for the relaxed chalcopyrite phase using DFPT with a supercell via PHONOPY. Assess dynamical stability by checking for imaginary modes (negative squared frequency).
description: Output a single JSON object with keys: stable (boolean: true if no imaginary modes), min_squared_frequency (float, THz²; the smallest squared frequency; must be >= 0 for stability).

title: Polycrystalline moduli (VRH averages)
action: From the single-crystal elastic constants, compute polycrystalline bulk modulus B_VRH, shear modulus G_VRH, Young's modulus Y_VRH, and Poisson's ratio ν_VRH using Voigt–Reuss–Hill averaging.
description: Produce a JSON array of objects, each with keys: compound (string), B_VRH, G_VRH, Y_VRH (float, GPa), Poisson_VRH (float, dimensionless). One object per compound.
output_schema: Array of objects: {compound: string, B_VRH: number, G_VRH: number, Y_VRH: number, Poisson_VRH: number}

title: Elastic anisotropy extremes
action: Calculate the elastic compliance tensor S, then compute directional Young's modulus and linear compressibility as functions of direction (θ,φ) and extract the minimum and maximum values for each compound.
description: Output a JSON array of objects, each with keys: compound (string), Y_min, Y_max (float, GPa), beta_min, beta_max (float, TPa⁻¹). These represent the extremes of the directional Young's modulus and linear compressibility surfaces.
output_schema: Array of objects: {compound: string, Y_min: number, Y_max: number, beta_min: number, beta_max: number}

title: Total energy vs volume curves for all phases
action: Perform a series of DFT total energy calculations at multiple fixed volumes for the chalcopyrite (I-42d), orthorhombic (Pna2₁), and cubic (Fm-3m) phases of each compound, relaxing internal coordinates at each volume. Obtain E(V) data for subsequent phase transition analysis.
description: Produce a structure (e.g., JSON) containing for each compound and phase the volume and total energy pairs. This intermediate is used to compute phase transition pressures.

title: Phase transition pressures
action: From the E(V) data, compute enthalpies H = E + pV and determine the crossing pressures for the I-42d → Pna2₁ and I-42d → Fm-3m transitions for each compound.
description: Output a JSON array of objects, each with keys: compound (string), Pt_I42d_Pna21 (float, GPa), Pt_I42d_Fm3m (float, GPa). One object per compound.
output_schema: Array of objects: {compound: string, Pt_I42d_Pna21: number, Pt_I42d_Fm3m: number}
